scope: Matched single-GX10 operator pilot on the exact abliterated Headroom128 target
claim_if_passed: Entrpi ds4 v0.6.2 plus the pinned 0731 Q2K/Q8 DSpark drafter increases served wall tokens per second on the exact apetersson abliterated Headroom128 target versus the same runtime with speculation disabled, without a material regression on the frozen deterministic canaries.

dspark.treatment: same target and runtime, --dspark with the pinned clean 0731 Q2K/Q8 drafter and shipped quench policy
dspark.note: The target repository's bundled abliterated support GGUF uses the older metadata/name contract and failed the v0.6.2 validator before inference. It is retained as compatibility evidence, not used in the primary arm.

request_contract.thinking: disabled by the served model alias
request_contract.speed_metric: completion_tokens divided by non-streaming request wall seconds, reported explicitly as served wall tok/s

harness.generated_code_sandbox: Docker python:3.13-alpine, no network, read-only root, unprivileged UID, all capabilities dropped, no-new-privileges, 1 CPU, 256 MiB, 64 PIDs, 20 second wall limit, execution canary required

primary_analysis.overall_speedup: geometric mean of the four DSpark/plain fixture-median ratios
primary_analysis.eligible_speed_row: HTTP 200, no error, finite elapsed time, positive completion_tokens, validator result retained
primary_analysis.quality_rate: passed deterministic validators over all 24 planned canary rows
primary_analysis.exact_output_identity: reported by request family and repetition but not required for semantic GO

go_gates: at least 23 of 24 deterministic quality canaries pass in each arm
no repeated failure of the tool-call or sandboxed-code canary
swap growth no more than 512 MiB from each arm boot baseline
no unrelated model-scale process introduced during measurement
followups_if_go: repeat the winning DSpark arm after a fresh reload
run a bounded concurrency ladder at 1, 2, 4, and 8 requests
package the result as a matched pilot, not a universal model claim
followups_if_no_go: retain the result as a runtime/drafter compatibility or workload no-go
use DS4_DSPARK_TRACE and the offline replayer to test a bounded quench-policy amendment
do not tune on quality canary answers

safety.action_on_breach: kill only the active ds4-speed experiment unit and retain incident evidence

superseded_primary_v1.status: ineligible for the matched primary claim
superseded_primary_v1.reason: The harness derived speed-request nonces from arm plus fixture plus repetition, so the two arms did not receive identical prompt bytes. It also prefixed deterministic quality canaries with an instruction-conflicting nonce sentence.
superseded_primary_v1.retained_evidence: All 72 rows and safety telemetry are preserved. They are discovery evidence only.
v2_corrections: derive speed nonces from fixture and repetition only
remove nonce prefixes from quality canaries
replace an ambiguous reasoning fixture with an unambiguous calculation whose answer is 89
score fenced JSON for semantic content while retaining strict-envelope evidence
align the code hidden test with the prompt's standard overlap-or-shared-endpoint contract

preprimary_smoke.result: candidate loaded on sm_121, /v1/models returned HTTP 200, arithmetic canary passed, DSpark accepted 32 of 34 drafted tokens on the warm-up trace; the 65,536-context, four-bank smoke was then stopped by the frozen swap-growth watchdog at 551,968,768 bytes, 15,097,856 bytes over the 512 MiB limit

amendment_1.reason: The pre-primary smoke crossed the frozen swap-growth guard while retaining 16.4 GiB MemAvailable. Preserve the guard and reduce only the matched operating envelope.
